quote: Every vehicle upon a highway of this State, subject to exceptions with respect to parked vehicles as stated in chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS, must display lighted lamps and illuminating devices as respectively required in this chapter for different classes of vehicles: (a) At any time from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise; (b) At any other time when, because of insufficient light or unfavorable atmospheric conditions, persons and vehicles on the highway are not clearly discernible at a distance of 1,000 feet ahead; and (c) When directed by an official traffic control device.

activation.condition: An ordinary motor vehicle travels on a Nevada highway, and an operative official traffic-control device directs lamp use on its route. The independent sunset/sunrise and poor-visibility clauses remain separately measured context.

obligation.description: Display the lighted lamps and illuminating devices respectively required for this vehicle class when directed by the operative official device.

exceptions.source_clause: subject to exceptions with respect to parked vehicles as stated in chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS
exceptions.description: Parked-vehicle exceptions require independent review; the selected ego travels and is not parked.

timing.description: Source-bound operative device interval and original frame/time identify when its direction applies. Sunset/sunrise half-hour and 1,000-foot visibility alternatives are measured independently.
